question: What dual nature characterizes the glorious deity whose body consists of five mantras?
premises: The glorious deity has a body of five mantras.
The deity is described as sakala.
The deity is described as niṣkala.
inference: Therefore the glorious five-mantra-bodied deity is both with parts and without parts.
plain_english: The glorious deity, whose body consists of the five mantras, is both with parts and without parts.
